rules.statement: A plaintiff can maintain an action on a mortgage bond even after accepting a conveyance that was void due to the properties being under seizure, if he acted in ignorance of this fact.
rules.supporting_quote: "I hold, therefore, that the plaintiff is entitled to maintain his action on the mortgage bond, and that the second defendant was rightly joined as a purchaser in execution of four out of the five lands mortgaged to the plaintiff."
